subject: Staged acceptance ladder & smoke-test scripts for Clearview pilot
messages:
From: Sarah Lowe <sarah.lowe@clearviewhealth.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procure@clearviewhealth.com>
Date: 2025-09-29T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot acceptance criteria + mutual action plan request

Hi Rachel,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — our product team liked the inference latency and the model fallback story. Before we sign a pilot SOW we need a clear mutual action plan that spells out success criteria and exit gates for the 4-week evaluation window. Key asks from our side:

- A compact list of acceptance tests (functional + perf + security) we can run, ideally with pass/fail thresholds.
- A short staged acceptance ladder so we can approve incremental signoffs (dev -> staging -> production-ready).
- A proposed timeline and a minimal set of deliverables we can attach to the SOW.

Our rough target: pilot kickoff week of Oct 6, go/no-go decision by end of October. Can you send a draft MAP and suggested smoke tests by early next week? Also loop in anyone on your side who owns infra or dedicated capacity so we can validate any VPC/network prerequisites.

Regards,
Sarah
Head of Product
Clearview Health

P.S. Procurement will want a DocuSign-friendly MAP that we can attach to the SOW — copying them here.

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lowe <sarah.lowe@clearviewhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-09-29T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Pilot acceptance criteria + mutual action plan request

Hi Sarah — appreciate the clear ask. Attaching a first-pass MAP and a short smoke-test script doc. High-level proposal below; full details in the attachments.

Proposed staged acceptance ladder (3 gates):
1) Integration sanity (day 0-3): successful API connectivity, auth, and basic prompts.
   - Smoke test: end-to-end prompt -> generated response (sanity).
2) Functional correctness (week 1-2): model meets 3 curated prompt suites with >=90% concordance to the expected answers (manual sample).
   - Smoke test: 50 sample prompts across core intents, target concordance >=90%.
3) Performance & resilience (week 2-4): production traffic profile soak with target p95 latency <250ms and no more than 1% error rate; fallback behavior verified for overloaded routes.
   - Smoke tests: 5-minute warm-cache p95, 1-minute burst to 2x expected TPS, fallback switch test.

Mandatory exit gates before go/no-go:
- Security: SOC 2 evidence checklist items completed (we'll provide links; procurement included).
- Data handling: retention and KMS policy agreed.
- Ops: rollout/runbook and rollback plan reviewed with your on-call.

Deliverables we will provide: MAP spreadsheet (attached), smoke-test scripts (attached), one-page runbook, and a signed mutual action plan PDF suitable for DocuSign.

Can you confirm two things: 1) who on your side will own the concordance review (product or clinical?), and 2) expected daily token budget so we can size capacity? I’ll also pull Ben and Lauren into a quick sync to cover Dedicated vs Hosted options and any VPC needs.

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Principal Sales Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Clearview-MAP-v0.2.xlsx (MAP draft), smoke-test-scenarios.md (scripts)

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-09-29T11:10:00-07:00
Subject: FW: Pilot acceptance criteria + mutual action plan request

Team — forwarding Clearview's request. They want a MAP + smoke tests and are targeting Oct 6. Quick items I need from you by EOD tomorrow:
- Ben: sizing & cost delta for Reserved/Dedicated pool vs Hosted for the expected pilot (I'll share token estimates once they confirm). Also recommend one fragility/perf test we should require for the exit gate.
- Lauren: VPC/onboarding timeline if they choose Private; any network pre-reqs we should call out in the MAP.

I'll consolidate and send back to Sarah early next week.
Rachel

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-09-29T15:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FW: Pilot acceptance criteria + mutual action plan request

Rachel — quick notes:
- Pricing: For a 4-week pilot under expected volume (assume 200K tokens/day), hosted usage will be simplest; estimate ~ $X, whereas Dedicated reserved slice (1x A10G-equivalent pool warm) would add a ~30% uplift but guarantees capacity for the perf gates. I can put real numbers in spreadsheet once token profile is final.
- Perf acceptance test to include: 10-minute warm-cache soak at 1.5x expected TPS and a 60s burst to 2.5x to verify graceful degradation + fallback. Capture p50/p95/p99 and error rate.
- Also recommend including a KV-cache-hit-rate check for prompt families that are cacheable — >60% cache hit during soak improves unit cost.

I attached a quick token-traffic-profile.csv you can share with the customer as an example.

Ben
Solutions Architect

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lowe <sarah.lowe@clearviewhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Procurement <procure@clearviewhealth.com>
Date: 2025-10-01T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot acceptance criteria + mutual action plan request

Hi Sarah — thanks for the clarity. Attached is an updated MAP (v0.3) that folds in Ben's perf gating and Lauren's onboarding checklist. Consolidated timeline suggestion:

- Oct 6: Pilot kickoff (integration sanity).
- Oct 7-14: Functional correctness tests + concordance review (your team to own concordance signoff).
- Oct 15-24: Performance soak and resilience tests (Redwood runs soak with you; monitoring dashboards shared).
- Oct 27: Draft findings and remediation list.
- Oct 31: Go / No-Go review (decision & next-steps).

Acceptance tests (summary):
- Sanity: Basic end-to-end prompt -> response (pass/fail).
- Concordance: 50-sample manual review >=90% on primary intents.
- Perf soak: 10-minute warm-cache soak at 1.5x TPS, p95 <250ms, error rate <1%.
- Burst/fallback: 60s 2.5x burst, graceful fallback to cheaper variant with no data loss.
- Security: SOC 2 checklist items A-C completed (procurement to validate).

Next steps: please confirm
1) the concordance owner (product/clinical) and a 1-2 person reviewer list,
2) nominal daily token target for the pilot so Ben can finalize pricing, and
3) whether you want the MAP returned as a PDF for DocuSign (we can produce a DocuSign-ready file).

Link to draft MAP: https://drive.google.com/open?id=clearview-map-v0.3
DocuSign stub: https://docusign.com/req/CLV-MAP-0421

If that timeline looks OK I’ll convert MAP v0.3 into a DocuSign-ready PDF and route it for signature.

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Principal Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Clearview-MAP-v0.3.xlsx, smoke-test-scenarios.md, token-traffic-profile.csv

From: Procurement <procure@clearviewhealth.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Sarah Lowe <sarah.lowe@clearviewhealth.com>
Date: 2025-10-03T16:48:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Pilot acceptance criteria + mutual action plan request

Rachel — procurement here. Confirming we will run the SOC2 evidence review in parallel but procurement approves the proposed timeline and accepts the exit gate list as stated (subject to evidence). Please send the DocuSign-ready MAP PDF and we will countersign once procurement items A-C are satisfied.

Point of contact for contract is: procurement@clearviewhealth.com

Thanks,
Clearview Procurement
